name: usertold
description: Capture in-product interviews and return source-linked evidence for verified product work.

interface.longDescription: Plan truthful participant recruitment; capture consented voice, supported desktop screen, and in-product behavior; inspect source-linked analysis; prepare verified work; and export portable research handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Learn this product, create its UserTold project, and propose interviews for its landing page and core product workflow.
Create and activate UserTold studies for new visitors on / and experienced users on core product pages; install the widget.
Review completed UserTold interviews and Evidence, triage Findings, and create tracker issues only after I approve fixes.
